sources.title: StanForD 2010
sources.claim: StanForD2010 is an XML-based open interface for control, reporting and monitoring/follow-up of forestry machines; version and implementation must be established for the actual source.
sources.status: authoritative documentation; not evidence of availability on a particular machine

sources.title: StanForD2010 documentation and schemas
sources.claim: Official documentation lists multiple schema versions; a parser must use the version indicated by the incoming message rather than infer it from a machine model.
sources.status: authoritative documentation; field presence remains untested

sources.title: Volymsbestämning för flerträdshanterande aggregat
sources.claim: Multi-tree processing cannot continuously measure each stem as single-tree processing does; bundle estimates may over- or under-estimate depending on stem size composition.
sources.status: authoritative research summary; not a universal error rate

sources.title: Measure up! A Skogforsk Guide to Harvester Measurement
sources.claim: The guide describes length measurement by a measuring wheel and diameter measurement by delimbing knives or feed rollers; manual control measurements support calibration.
sources.status: authoritative guide; no machine-specific calibration result

sources.title: Introduction to StanForD 2010
sources.claim: The introduction describes harvested production and operational-monitoring messages, including HPR reporting context.
sources.status: official draft; must be paired with the actual schema/version

sources.title: StanForD2010 rules v1p5
sources.claim: Rules describe HPR handling and recommend ZIP/DEFLATE for compressed files; schema validation alone cannot test every semantic dependency.
sources.status: authoritative rules; not proof that a supplier exports HPR

sources.title: 1С:Управление лесозаготовительным предприятием. Модуль для 1С:ERP и 1С:КА — возможности
sources.claim: The sector module is designed for forestry accounting from forest areas through shipment of roundwood and lists logging and acceptance processes.
sources.status: official product description; customer installation/version unknown

sources.title: Documentation: 1С:Управление лесозаготовительным предприятием. Модуль для 1С:ERP и 1С:КА
sources.claim: The documentation enumerates roundwood harvesting, acceptance and measurement documents, reference data and deviation reports.
sources.status: official documentation; target metadata and release need pilot inspection

sources.title: 1С:Предприятие 8. Лесозавод
sources.claim: The solution is marked withdrawn from sale and historically covered forestry harvesting, receipt and shipment.
sources.status: official product description; not selected as a default target

sources.title: REST-интерфейс платформы

sources.claim: EnterpriseDataUpload supports one-way import and EnterpriseDataExchange supports two-way exchange when required services are deployed and configured.

sources.title: Forest machine data easily available to customers
sources.claim: Ponsse describes a Data API for customer reporting and ERP use, illustrating that manufacturer data access is a separate provider-specific arrangement.
sources.status: manufacturer statement; access scope, licensing and Russia availability not verified

volume_checks.name: Native-volume identity gate
volume_checks.inputs: volume_m3; bark_basis; volume_method_id; method_version; source_message_id; source_record_id; source_hash
volume_checks.formula: Accept native display only when every required provenance field is present; otherwise status=insufficient_inputs.
volume_checks.result: Target design: a value would be labelled machine_report rather than silently treated as a comparable accounting volume.
volume_checks.meaning: The API preserves what the machine reported and the basis needed for later reconciliation.
volume_checks.limitation: Presence of metadata does not prove calibration, physical correctness or data-access authorization.

volume_checks.name: Illustrative Smalian calculation
volume_checks.inputs: L=4.000 m; d1=0.300 m; d2=0.260 m; diameters and length are treated as over-or-under-bark only if the record says so
volume_checks.meaning: Two end diameters and a length can yield a reproducible geometric calculation.
volume_checks.limitation: Illustration only; it is not a mandated harvester, StanForD, ГОСТ or acceptance formula.

volume_checks.name: Illustrative Huber calculation
volume_checks.inputs: L=4.000 m; dm=0.280 m; mean diameter only
volume_checks.meaning: A different geometric model produces a different result from the same illustrative dimensions.
volume_checks.limitation: The machine method, bark treatment, profile extrapolation and rounding are unknown until supplied by the actual source.

volume_checks.name: Local formula sensitivity
volume_checks.inputs: Smalian illustration: L=4.000 m; d1=0.300 m; d2=0.260 m; perturbations ±0.010 m length and ±0.001 m diameter
volume_checks.result: Smalian length ±0.010 m gives ±0.0006189 m3; d1 ±0.001 m gives ±0.0009425 m3; d2 ±0.001 m gives ±0.0008168 m3; Huber dm ±0.001 m gives ±0.0017593 m3.
volume_checks.meaning: The entries are mathematical derivatives for this example and help test unit conversions.
volume_checks.limitation: They are not measured machine error, calibration tolerance or a confidence interval.

volume_checks.name: Three-pair comparable-basis reconciliation
volume_checks.inputs: Synthetic pairs only: P-01 machine=10.000 m3 receipt=9.800 m3; P-02 machine=8.500 m3 receipt=8.670 m3; P-03 machine=5.000 m3 receipt=5.000 m3; same assortment, bark basis, method and period within each pair
volume_checks.meaning: The test validates pair keys and weighted aggregation without averaging naked percentages.
volume_checks.limitation: These are fabricated arithmetic fixtures, not empirical receipts; incomparable bark/method/party records must be rejected from this calculation.

volume_checks.name: Confidence-interval eligibility
volume_checks.inputs: Predefined representative sampling plan; paired errors; independence assessment; selected interval method; enough observations under that plan
volume_checks.formula: Report an interval only for the explicitly defined statistic and assumptions; do not use a fixed universal n threshold.
volume_checks.result: No 95% confidence interval is reported now.
volume_checks.meaning: A statistical interval is conditional evidence, not a generic accuracy badge.
volume_checks.limitation: No samples, representative design or calibration history have been supplied.

integration.validation: Any unrecognized version is rejected before document creation.

integration.target: Idempotency register in the custom 1С extension
integration.transformation: Use the pair as immutable external event identity.
integration.validation: A repeated pair returns the stored result and document_uid without creating a second document.
integration.status: proposed; no database or 1С test performed

integration.transformation: Resolve only against a customer-approved external-code table.
integration.validation: Missing or ambiguous mapping is rejected; legal entity name is not needed in the product payload.

integration.target: Logging complex or fixed-asset reference chosen in the target configuration
integration.transformation: Resolve through an allowlisted asset mapping.
integration.validation: Do not accept an operator name, personnel number or free-text substitution.

integration.transformation: Store UTC and apply the configured IANA plant timezone only for local business presentation.
integration.validation: UTC and timezone must be present and parseable; no silent server-time conversion.

integration.transformation: Resolve only through preapproved site mapping.
integration.validation: Unknown site is rejected rather than created as an uncontrolled directory item.

integration.target: Nomenclature, characteristic and grade references selected during pilot
integration.transformation: Resolve each external code through versioned approved NСИ mapping.
integration.validation: All required codes must map; blank or fallback values are rejected.
integration.status: proposed; no mapping has been approved

integration.transformation: Resolve a code to a warehouse available for the mapped organization.
integration.validation: Reject a missing, inaccessible or organization-mismatched warehouse.
integration.status: proposed; configuration and access rights unknown

integration.transformation: Map allowed action harvest_production to the agreed logging-production scenario.
integration.validation: Reject every action not in the target's approved allowlist.
integration.status: proposed; 1С:ERP Управление предприятием 2 is only a candidate target

integration.field: volume_m3 plus bark_basis plus volume_method_id plus rounding_rule
integration.target: Quantity and traceability attributes of the target document
integration.transformation: Use Decimal m3; preserve the stated bark basis and method; do not make an implicit conversion.
integration.validation: Volume must be greater than zero; bark basis, method and rounding rule must match approved dictionaries.
integration.status: proposed; no direct EnterpriseData, OData, XML or CSV load exists

integration.transformation: Use source_kind plus stable logical source_message_id plus source_record_id as immutable identity; store source_hash separately. A new filename or export hash must not create a new product identity; snapshot reconciliation needs a source-specific adapter.
integration.validation: A same-identity/same-hash replay is idempotent; a same-identity/different-hash delivery enters conflict quarantine and never creates a second volume.
integration.status: proposed; raw HPR is processed only in an approved customer-local isolated processor and is not uploaded to the cloud app

integration.target: HTTP response from the custom extension
integration.transformation: Return event_id, status, document_uid only when accepted, rejection_code, schema_version and processed_at_utc.
integration.validation: An error must leave no partial movements or partially posted document after transaction rollback.
integration.status: proposed; transaction behavior requires test in the agreed 1С release

field_tests.equipment: One specific harvester, head, onboard-computer software/version evidence, supplier agreement and an approved sample export or API sandbox
field_tests.steps: Record model/head/software/licence; establish data channel; identify schema/type/fields/units and compare them with a documented allowlist.
field_tests.expected: A signed capability matrix separates present, exportable, absent and unknown fields.
field_tests.pass_criterion: No field is represented as supported until it appears in the approved source and its unit/basis is documented.
field_tests.evidence: Versioned capability matrix; sanitized source manifest; parser-validation report; access authorization record.
field_tests.status: not tested; no machine or source sample supplied

field_tests.equipment: Approved synthetic and production-permitted HPR fixtures, schema validator, hash ledger and customer-local isolated parser
field_tests.steps: Validate the exact schema version; submit valid, duplicate, truncated, oversized and unknown-field fixtures; inspect accepted/rejected results.
field_tests.expected: Only valid, complete and allowed projections enter the normalized store; same-identity/same-hash replay creates no duplicate and changed payload enters quarantine.
field_tests.pass_criterion: Every negative fixture receives a deterministic rejection code; no duplicate source record is created; same identity with different hash has no volume effect.
field_tests.evidence: Fixture hashes; validation logs; acceptance/rejection ledger; automated-test output.
field_tests.status: not tested; no actual HPR file supplied

field_tests.test: Blind manual measurement and calibration holdout
field_tests.equipment: Calibrated measuring tape, calibrated calliper, physical non-personal log tags, independent measurer, authorized machine-calibration specialist
field_tests.steps: Pre-register stratified sample rules; independently measure selected logs without seeing machine results; pair after lock; calibrate through authorized onboard controls; remeasure an operator-independent held-out sample not used for adjustment.
field_tests.expected: Paired errors e_i, absolute errors and volume-weighted aggregate are reproducible before and after calibration.
field_tests.pass_criterion: The held-out result meets a tolerance and method pre-agreed by the customer for the exact machine/head/assortment/bark basis; no universal tolerance is asserted.
field_tests.evidence: Instrument calibration records; selection protocol; blinded sheets; immutable source export; calibration-change record; holdout analysis.
field_tests.status: not tested; no physical machine, logs or approved tolerance supplied

field_tests.test: Receipt reconciliation of three comparable pilot lots
field_tests.equipment: Three traceable production lots, machine reports, physical dispatch identifiers and receipt/measurement documents
field_tests.steps: Match each lot using agreed party, period, species, assortment, bark basis, method and units; calculate e_i and weighted aggregate; route non-comparable lots to review.
field_tests.expected: Each accepted pair has complete provenance and a reproducible difference calculation.
field_tests.pass_criterion: All three pairs are comparable under the pre-agreed basis; unmatched or basis-mismatched entries are not counted as losses.
field_tests.evidence: Lot crosswalk; source identifiers; receipt document references; reconciliation report; exception queue.
field_tests.status: not tested; synthetic arithmetic only exists in this research note

field_tests.equipment: Customer-authorized non-production 1С test base, exact configuration/release metadata, minimal technical user and custom HTTP extension
field_tests.steps: Submit a valid normalized event; repeat it; submit unmapped NСИ, invalid bark basis, invalid volume and a forced posting failure; inspect documents and registers.
field_tests.expected: The valid event creates one agreed document; replay returns the same document_uid; invalid events are rejected and failure rolls back.
field_tests.pass_criterion: No partial document or movement remains after every rejected case and the accepted document is visible in the agreed 1С business scenario.
field_tests.evidence: Metadata export; endpoint configuration; request/response audit; document UID; rollback evidence; customer sign-off.
field_tests.status: not tested; no 1С base, exact release or extension exists

field_tests.equipment: Ingress schema, edge projection configuration, test telemetry/HPR fixture and storage-access audit
field_tests.steps: Inject prohibited names, personnel IDs, emails, operator profiles, raw GPS traces and free text; inspect request logs, database, backups and 1С payload.
field_tests.expected: Only allowlisted technical/aggregation fields persist; prohibited fields are rejected or removed at the edge before storage.
field_tests.pass_criterion: No prohibited field reaches product storage or 1С payload, and GPS/time use has an approved purpose, retention and role policy.
field_tests.evidence: Schema rules; projection test report; access logs; retention configuration; privacy review.
field_tests.status: not tested; data-protection policy and real integration are not yet supplied
